reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model 96775 (KY-318A), which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The purchase is from ALDI, a listed retailer, dated 2017-02-14, which is inside the 2016-2019 sale window. No receipt is required.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this one.
The destruction photo shows an intact power cord with no cut, so it does not show the required destruction (unplugged power cord cut). Under the policy this is asked for again rather than denied.

input.question_for_claimant: Thank you for your claim. Your label and purchase check out, but the destruction photo does not show the power cord cut. Please send a new photo of the unplugged cooker with its power cord cut through, as the recall instructs.
